stem: Esha reads the statement "$35\%$ of the school garden." The whole is the school garden.

parts.text: Which claim correctly states what $35\%$ means?

options.text: $35\%$ means $35$ out of every $100$ equal parts of the school garden.
$35\%$ means $35$ out of every $10$ equal parts of the school garden.
$35\%$ means $100$ out of every $35$ equal parts of the school garden.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: A percentage is a fraction with denominator 100, so 35% means 35/100 of the chosen whole (the school garden).

teacher.key_rationale: x% means x/100 of the named whole. Here 35% is 35 out of every 100 parts of the school garden.
